name: Luggage
question: Will this bag fit a 22 × 14 × 9 in size benchmark?

filters.label: Fits 22 × 14 × 9 in
filters.hint: Compare overall size, including wheels and handles. This is a size benchmark, not an airline promise.
filters.edge_case: Body-only dimensions are Measured differently and excluded. Preserve L/W/D order; do not rotate or compress.

filters.label: Empty weight
filters.hint: Less bag weight leaves more room for your belongings.
filters.edge_case: Use empty weight; exclude packed weight.

filters.label: Shell
filters.hint: Choose the construction that suits your packing.
filters.edge_case: Use the brand’s explicit hard or soft classification.

filters.label: Wheels
filters.edge_case: Count wheel assemblies, not individual tires.

display_fields.label: Overall size with wheels and handles
display_fields.hint: Overall dimensions determine the size benchmark.
display_fields.edge_case: Use L × W × D including wheels and handles; body-only dimensions are Measured differently.

explainer.title: Why body size and overall size differ
explainer.text: Body size can omit wheels and handles. The benchmark uses only comparable overall dimensions in L × W × D order. It does not establish an airline’s allowance; check your carrier before travel.
